lead: BRS plans, delivers, assembles and cleans up after your office furniture project, so your team can get back to their workstations quickly.
card_blurb: Planned delivery, assembly and clean-up of new office furniture, with IT and electrical support when needed.
meta_description: Planned delivery, assembly and clean-up of commercial office furniture, with IT and electrical support, so staff are back at their desks sooner.
overview: Installation is one of the most important parts of an office furniture project, and it should be planned together with furniture selection. BRS helps you plan and organize new installations or reconfigure your current space.
Our project managers and installers handle delivery, assembly and clean-up. The goal is minimal interference with your office's productivity.

benefits.title: Planned with your selection
benefits.text: Installation is scheduled alongside your furniture choices, not left until the last minute.

benefits.title: Less lost productivity
benefits.text: Employees are often displaced during a project. We work to get them back to their workstations as soon as possible.

benefits.title: One team on site
benefits.text: BRS can bring IT personnel and electricians in to get the space up and running.

included: Planning and organizing new furniture installations
Reconfiguration of your current office space
Electricians where the project needs them

process.title: Plan the install
process.text: We plan the installation with your furniture selection and the layout of your space.

process.title: Deliver and assemble
process.text: Our installers deliver and assemble the furniture in a coordinated sequence.

process.title: Connect and clean up
process.text: IT and electrical staff get the workstations running, and we clear the space so staff can return.

who_for: Companies moving into a new office
Businesses refreshing or reconfiguring their current space
Facilities managers running a furniture project
Organizations that need workstations ready for displaced staff

faq.q: Does BRS handle IT and electrical work for an installation?
faq.a: BRS can bring IT personnel and electricians into the project to help get it up and running.

faq.q: Can you reconfigure our existing furniture?
faq.a: Yes. We help plan and organize new installations or reconfigure your current office space.
Yes. Delivery, installation and clean-up are part of how we handle a furniture project.
